policy_notes: Primary issuer/SEC evidence leads quantitative company claims; TrendForce and Reuters provide independent industry and execution context.
Management forecasts for FY2026 and medium-term AI/revenue growth are estimates, not realized facts.
Foundry share is a TrendForce estimate and not an audited issuer fact.
Native NTD statements lead the TTM bridge; USD translation uses a diagnostic rate only and is not presented as reported constant-currency accounting.
The September 10 ADR price is a secondary historical-market reference and not an execution guarantee.
Existing Bear/Base/Bull endpoints are retained for comparability rather than rewritten after one strong quarter/month.
A Taiwan geopolitical catastrophe is maintained as a separate tail-risk overlay rather than embedded in the ordinary Bear case with arbitrary probability precision.
